text:
maria: Heads up: ran end-to-end perf run on a canary allocator+kernel tweak (boundary-aware slimcap). Observed KV cache pressure spikes on long chats; a few OOMs on 16GB GPU hosts. Posting a short profiler dump and notes.

aj: thx — can you share config + pprof?

maria: config: `SLIMCAP_BOUNDARY=0.85, PREFILL_CAP_PER_REQ=24MB, DECODE_CAP_PER_REQ=40MB`, 1k chat sessions. profiler shows frequent small workspace allocs during decode stage, plus repeated KV demote/evict cycles.

maria: profiler snippet:
```
alloc_histogram: {small: 72%, medium: 20%, large: 8%}
frag_ratio: 0.18
kv_evictions/sec: 14
oom_count: 3
hotpath: kernel_route->decode_buffer_alloc
```

kevin: looks like the new kernel routing prefers high-throughput kernels that fragment the slab allocator more. fragmentation up ~18% vs baseline which explains lost coalescing.

liam: could be buffer aliasing helps — coalesce temporary decode buffers into streamer buffers when lifetimes don't overlap. also consider moving low-token batches to streaming kernel to avoid large contiguous allocations.

nina: what about reducing PREFILL_CAP_PER_REQ? prefill is retaining many KV segments that prevent packing larger decode buffers.

maria: lowered PREFILL_CAP to 12MB in a short run — 95p latency improved, but decode sometimes stalled waiting for reclaimed space; net OOMs went up for long conversations. tradeoff seems workload-dependent.

perfbot: Perf run summary: baseline 95th=210ms, canary 95th=222ms (+12ms), OOMs 3->7, avg token cost +4%.

aj: proposal: adaptive slimcap + eviction hysteresis. If frag_ratio > 0.12 and evict_rate < target, temporarily tighten SLIMCAP_BOUNDARY and trigger a background coalesce pass. Pseudocode:
```
if frag_ratio > FRAG_THRESH:
  SLIMCAP_BOUNDARY *= 0.9
  trigger_compact(background=true)
if evictable_kv_bytes < MIN_EVICTABLE and incoming_decode > X:
  prefer_streaming_kernel()
```

kevin: also add a metric 'evictable_kv_bytes' and 'slow_coalesce_count' so routing can pick hosts with reclaimable memory for big decodes.

maria: plan: canary rollout -> set BOUNDARY=0.8 and PREFILL_CAP=16MB at 10% traffic on nv16-std. Collect frag_ratio, evictable_kv_bytes, oom_count, 95p latency. Will enable compact pass when frag_ratio>0.15.

liam: :thumbsup: add alert: if oom_count > 0 in 1h window during canary, abort and roll back.

deploy-bot: Canary scheduled: rdw-canary-allocator v2 -> 10% on nv16-std at 2026-03-18T12:30Z

nina: also keep kernel fallback to compat model when compaction fails to free enough contiguous space.

maria: thanks — I'll push the metric + compact hook. Will update this thread with graphs and a short follow-up run after 24h.
